summary.zh: 内容刷新按实际执行刷新的 agents-init 副本判断是否落后，并遵循 --client 与忽略设置；其他客户端的旧副本只提示升级，不再阻塞内容更新；所有可用副本过旧时写明客户端、版本、路径和下一步命令（#48）。
summary.en: Content refresh decides staleness from the agents-init copy that actually runs it, honoring --client and ignore settings; older copies in other clients only produce an upgrade note instead of blocking; when every usable copy is too old the client, version, path and next command are reported (#48).
